stories.title: AI uncovers hidden bladder cancer warning signs years before diagnosis
stories.synopsis: Researchers at the University of Plymouth have built an AI system that can spot hidden warning signs of bladder cancer up to five years before a diagnosis. In a major study of nearly 70,000 patients, it identified 85% of cases, and it can sort people into low-risk, uncertain and high-risk groups. That could help doctors catch a hard-to-spot cancer earlier, when treatment has the best chance to help.

stories.title: AI scientist autonomously generates and validates new biological discoveries
stories.synopsis: Researchers at Sweden's Chalmers University of Technology have created an AI scientist that can come up with hypotheses, design experiments and interpret the results. It works in a closed-loop AI laboratory studying brewer's yeast. The team hopes future systems like this will become valuable partners to human scientists tackling big questions in biology and medicine.

stories.title: How AI tools can redefine universal design to increase accessibility
stories.synopsis: Google Research introduces Natively Adaptive Interfaces, a framework for building apps that use multimodal AI to adapt to each user's needs, co-designed with disability communities. Examples include StreetReaderAI, which pairs an AI Describer with an AI Chat to answer questions, and Grammar Laboratory, a bilingual American Sign Language and English platform that gives students tutoring and feedback on their writing.
